repo.name: funkypitt's F-Droid Repo
repo.description: Pierre Gallaz's apps: the black-and-white, text-only Reader's family for e-ink and digital detox, retreat bells, and a few small tools. No ads, no tracking, no accounts. https://gallaz.ch/eink

application.name: 4 Minutes Breathing
application.summary: Five breathing techniques, one shape each, four minutes
application.desc: Pick a shape and follow the dot round it for four minutes: square (box 4-4-4-4), triangle (4-4-4), 4-7-8, petal (3-3-6), circle (coherent 5-5). Every edge is as long as the breath it stands for. No settings, no streaks, no account, no tracking. English and French.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: ePub Magazine reader
application.summary: EPUB reader for newspaper and magazine issues
application.desc: Opens an issue as a contents page — one card per article, by section — then each article on its own page, with previous / contents / next always on top. Made for daily EPUB issues on e-ink. Ordinary books open as in Book's Story, which it forks.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Funky's 2P Games
application.summary: 16 games for two on one phone, no connection needed
application.desc: 4 in a Row, Caro, Awalé, Memory, Duck Chess, Tank Wars, Word Clash, Reversi, Tennis, Pool, Carrom, Air Hockey, Mini Golf, Star Clash, Hangman and Horse Jump, for two players on one phone. Rules behind a ? in each game. Works without any connection and asks for no permission. No ads, no accounts, no purchases.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Le dictionnaire Littré
application.summary: Le Littré complet, hors ligne, sans publicité
application.desc: Les 78 599 entrées du dictionnaire d'Émile Littré, avec étymologies et citations, consultables sans connexion. Recherche instantanée, renvois cliquables, favoris, mot du jour en widget. Ni publicité ni compte. Données littre.org (François Gannaz), CC BY-SA 3.0.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: MP4 Remixer
application.summary: Makes videos square (1:1) or brings them down to 1080p or 720p
application.desc: Pick videos from the gallery, or share them to the app, then make them square, bring them down to 1080p or 720p, or both. For the square you drag a frame over each video to choose the part it keeps. The new videos go to Movies/MP4 Remixer and the originals are left alone. No network permission, no ads, no account.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: MP4 to MP3
application.summary: Turns videos into 320 kbps MP3 files, on the phone
application.desc: Pick videos, or share them to the app: each becomes a 320 kbps MP3 (LAME) in Downloads, ready to share. One screen, whole batches, and it keeps going in the background. No network permission, no ads, no account.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Reader's Audio Player
application.summary: Plain audio player that transcribes and translates on the phone
application.desc: Plays audio files and resumes each where it was left; speed 0.8–2×, lock-screen and Bluetooth controls, a resume widget. Transcribes on the phone with whisper.cpp into .txt files any app opens, and can translate the transcript, on the phone too — nothing is uploaded. Black and white, text only, six languages.
application.author: funkypitt

application.name: Reader's Books
application.summary: Black-and-white e-book reader: pages, not scrolling
application.desc: A shelf as a plain list; books as pages of text cut at whole lines, turned by a tap — made for e-ink. EPUB, MOBI, FB2, TXT; the place in each book is kept. No store, no account; the network is used only for the optional library on your own drive (WebDAV), listed by folder, a book downloaded when tapped. Highlights, comments and the page you are at are kept next to each book of the library and follow it to your other devices.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Reader's Bookshop
application.summary: Finds free e-books across the public-domain libraries
application.desc: Searches Project Gutenberg, Standard Ebooks, Wikisource, Bibliothèque numérique romande, Ebooks libres et gratuits, textos.info and the Internet Archive at once; Anna's Archive only if you turn it on. Says whether the author has been dead seventy years when the source gives the dates. Downloads the file and leaves the reading to your reader. Hosts nothing, no account. Black and white, text only.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Reader's Calendar
application.summary: Black-and-white, text-only calendar
application.desc: Shows the calendars the phone already syncs (Google, Infomaniak, Nextcloud…) as plain text: agenda, month, week, day. No colour codes — an event's calendar is named in words. Create, edit, repeat, remind, drag to move. No account or network of its own.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Reader's Detox
application.summary: Blocks social networks on the phone with a local DNS VPN
application.desc:
Blocks YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit, X and Substack outside the hours you allow. The filtering happens on the device: no proxy, no certificate, no account. While it blocks, sites and hours are locked, and five maths problems can stand between you and stopping it. Friction you choose, not parental control. Works on IPv6-only carriers. Black and white, text only, six languages.
Only the names of the sites you look up pass through the app, never the traffic itself. They go to your network's own name servers as usual; if those do not answer, the app asks Quad9, a Swiss non-profit name service, so that the phone keeps working.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Reader's Feeds
application.summary: Black-and-white, text-only RSS reader
application.desc: Your RSS and Atom sources as one plain list, articles read as pages cut at whole lines — no scrolling, for e-ink. OPML, saved articles, paid Substacks. No icons, no colours, no account. Fork of Pluralis.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Reader's Files
application.summary: A file manager that opens on a page of plain words, black and white
application.desc: It opens on a list, not a grid of cards: Downloads, Videos, Images, Audio, Documents, Apps, Archives, then the phone's storage and its root with the space left. ZIP files are browsed in place; 7z, rar, tar and their compressed forms are unpacked beside the archive. Viewers for pictures, video, audio, PDF and text are built in. A modified version of Prism File Explorer (GPL-3.0). No network permission, nothing collected.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Reader's Food Log
application.summary: A food journal made of photos
application.desc: One touch photographs what you are about to eat; the app labels it breakfast, lunch, dinner or snack and files it by day. No calories, no database, no typing. Activity in one tap, weight once a day with its curve. No network permission; the journal exports as a zip.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Reader's Installer and Updater
application.summary: Installs the Reader's apps and keeps them, and itself, up to date
application.desc: Open it once: the whole Reader's family is in the list, each app one tap from being installed; after that the updates come by themselves, the installer's own included. It can follow any other app the same way. A modified version of Obtainium (GPL-3.0), not affiliated with its authors. No account, no tracking.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Reader's Launcher
application.summary: Black-and-white, text-only launcher in the spirit of the Light Phone
application.desc: The home screen is one fixed page of words: no icons, no colours, no wallpaper. Text tiles for apps and categories; built-in clock, weather (MeteoSwiss or Open-Meteo, no key), agenda, tasks and notes; two books a swipe away. Swipe up for all apps, down for notifications. No ads, no tracking. Six languages.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Reader's Mindful Tool
application.summary: A bowl every X minutes, a timed sitting, bowls at set times
application.desc: Three things a meditator asks of a bowl: a strike every X minutes, a sitting of X minutes closed by three bowls, bowls at set times each day. Rung as exact alarms, so they sound through Doze and silent mode. Five bowls or your own file. No streaks, no guidance, no account.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Reader's Night Filter
application.summary: Grayscale, warm and dim screen in one tap, from the quick settings
application.desc: One switch turns the screen gray, as warm as the phone allows, and dim: Android's own colour correction, Night Light and extra dim driven together, and put back as they were when you switch off. The switch lives in the quick settings, in a home-screen widget and in the app. It needs a permission given once from a computer (one adb command, shown in the app); no root. Android does not let an app remove blue entirely, so the tint stops at the phone's warmest setting. No network permission, no account, nothing collected.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Reader's Notes
application.summary: Black-and-white plain-text notes, typed or dictated, WebDAV sync
application.desc: One list, one page: a note is a .txt file whose first line is its title. Type it or dictate it — speech is written on the phone by whisper.cpp, nothing is uploaded. Optional two-way sync with your own WebDAV folder (kDrive, Nextcloud…). No formatting, no folders, no account.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Reader's Phone
application.summary: A phone in large type, two colours, that can record a call and write it out
application.desc:
A call rings on the whole screen with the person's photo and name and two big buttons; missed calls stay at the top until answered with "call back" or "OK". Contacts read favourites, then the people called lately, then everyone; a keypad with large keys; the list of calls. Leave the call for another app and it stays in view: Android's own call notification with one big "hang up", and a wide green band that brings the call back.
Recording (off by default): a call is recorded and written out on the phone by whisper.cpp, the model fetched once and shared with the other Reader's apps. Android only gives the sound of a call to an accessibility service, so one has to be switched on; the settings say so. Tell the other person — in many countries the law requires it.
Six languages. No account; the network is used only to fetch the model.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Reader's Podcasts
application.summary: Text-only podcast player: subscribe, download, listen
application.desc: Channels, episodes, favourites, downloads: four plain lists, no artwork. Feeds are added by pasting or sharing a link, and an episode resumes where you stopped. It can be transcribed and translated on the phone, and read while it plays. No directory, no recommendations, no account: OPML and one settings file are the whole sync with the desktop twin.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Reader's Recorder
application.summary: Black-and-white voice recorder that transcribes on the phone
application.desc: One tap records a memo, a lecture or a conversation, screen off included. The phone itself writes the transcript (whisper.cpp), evens the loudness and can list the main points (beta) — nothing leaves it. Optional export to your own WebDAV folder. Text only, six languages.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Reader's Scanner
application.summary: Scans to searchable PDFs, text read on the phone
application.desc:
Photographs documents, one page or many: the page is found, straightened and cleaned, a blurred shot is flagged at once, and the text is read on the phone in seven languages. Each document becomes a searchable PDF, dated and named by you, filed in plain folders, shareable as PDF, pictures or text, and copied to your own WebDAV folder (kDrive, Nextcloud) if you like.
At first start you choose the engine: Google ML Kit (most reliable; closed code, needs Google Play services, sends usage statistics to Google, never your documents) or the free ones (the app's own page finder and Tesseract). Black and white, text only.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Reader's Tasks
application.summary: Black-and-white, text-only CalDAV task lists
application.desc: The open tasks of your CalDAV lists (Nextcloud, Infomaniak, Tasks.org, Radicale…) as plain text. Tick to complete, one line to add, long press for the rest. No priorities, no projects, no account with the app: your server, your password, on the phone only. Feeds the tasks tile of Reader's Launcher.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Retreat Player
application.summary: Plays retreat recordings offline; nothing can interrupt them
application.desc: Talks, bells and chanting for a meditation retreat, loaded from the phone, a public kDrive link or a podcast feed and kept in the app — airplane mode is fine. Playback holds a wake lock and the screen; a recording plays once, and nothing follows it. No ads, no account.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Retreat Timer
application.summary: Rings meditation bells on schedule, even in deep sleep
application.desc: Set the times of day; one bell or three ring at each, every day, so a retreat runs with no one at the bell. Exact alarms and a foreground service: they ring through lock, Doze and reboot, and a light says when the phone is ready. Five bowls at matched loudness or your own sound, and talks scheduled like bells. No ads, no account.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Retreat Walk
application.summary: Rings a bowl every so many minutes, until you stop it
application.desc: One number, one button. For switching partners in paired practice, or a regular call back to the present. Exact alarms timed from the start of the session, so the bells neither drift nor miss in Doze. No network permission.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Tank Wars Mobile
application.summary: Tank Wars (1992) rebuilt for touchscreens, two players
application.desc: The DOS artillery game by Kenneth Morse: angle, power, wind, no trajectory preview. 16 weapons, 3 defences, destructible terrain. Hot-seat on one phone, or online. No ads, no purchases.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Tchitchi
application.summary: A large, calm home screen for older people, safe from accidental changes
application.desc: A Windows Phone 7-style launcher: two columns of big square tiles that scroll. Tiles show each app's last three calls or messages, kept after they are read, and a person's photo calls them at a touch. It can also be the phone app: calls ring on the whole screen with the caller's photo and name in large type and two big buttons, and missed calls stay at the top of the home screen until answered with "call back" or "OK". The home screen cannot be changed by mistake: a long press counts only after eight seconds, then three questions must each be answered yes. Twelve themes. Messages are read from the notifications and kept on the phone only; no ads, no tracking.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Tchitchi Phone
application.summary: A phone app in large type for older people, calm and without surprises
application.desc: The phone of the Tchitchi launcher as an app of its own, for a phone that keeps its launcher. A call rings on the whole screen with the caller's photo and name in large type and two big buttons; missed calls stay at the top until answered with "call back" or "OK". Contacts read favourites, then the people called lately, then everyone, with a search field; a keypad with large keys; the list of calls. When another app is opened during a call, a wide green band stays at the top of the screen with the name and the time on the line, and a touch brings the call back. Twelve themes. No account, no network, nothing leaves the phone.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz

application.name: Timer for 9Barista
application.summary: Espresso timer for the 9Barista, three taps per brew
application.desc: Tap when the machine goes on the stove, tap when coffee appears, tap when done: heating time, then extraction with the 25–30 s zone marked, then grind advice. Vibrates at 25 s, 30 s and 8 min; the screen stays on. Unofficial, not affiliated with 9Barista Ltd. No network, no ads.
application.author: Pierre Gallaz
